messages:
maria: Heads up — syncing ISV onboarding for SDKs/adapters with LangChain + a couple gateway partners. Need alignment on certification checklist, SDK samples, and marketplace packaging. Who can join a quick 30m this week?
aj: I can do Thu 10am PT. Should we also bake in hardware packaging notes for partner images (NVIDIA, AWS Neuron)?
kevin: Thu 10 works for me. Proposed agenda: 1) cert criteria + pass/fail gating 2) sample apps + CI expectations 3) marketplace assets & metadata 4) launch comms + co-announcement owners
sophie: I'm OOO Thu, but Fri 9am PT is free. Also we need a tiny L1 compatibility harness (smoke tests across model variants) — I can sketch a prototype.
maria: Sophie, if you can drop a proto before the meeting that'd be great. @dev-rel-bot can you attach the latest SDK compatibility sheet?
dev-rel-bot: Uploaded: https://drive.internal/redwood/sdk-compatibility-v2.csv (permissions: partnerships-read) :thumbsup:
aj: For the checklist, can we make an explicit section for quantized model behavior + fallback strategy? Hardware partners care a lot about perf regressions.
kevin: Agreed. Also include a short code example we expect partners to ship. Example we shared with adapter partners: ```python from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient(api_key="<KEY>")
print(c.generate("Summarize: ..."))```
sophie: I'll prototype the harness as a Github Actions workflow that runs on push -> matrix over {model_variant, seq_len, quant_profile}. Will post draft PR to repo: github.com/redwood/integration-harness/pulls
maria: Excellent. Let's confirm: Thu 10am PT check-in with Aj & Kevin, Sophie will present Fri 9am PT unless she can do a short async demo early Fri. I'll create a calendar invite and a shared doc for the checklist.
kevin: Can you add marketplace asset examples (png icon, short description, sample calls + rate limits) to the doc? I'll draft copy for the listing.
maria: Yup — adding a checklist section: assets, docs, verified tests, SLA & contact, support playbook. Meeting invite sent: /events/meet/1812345678. Thanks everyone :rocket:
